title: Photosensitized cyclic-ketone skeletal rearrangement and relative stereochemistry
difficulty_reasons: The local skeletal rearrangement requires computed electronic-state accessibility and actual C–C bond formation, cleavage, ring expansion and product connectivity.
Comparisons of cis/trans structures and compatible energies must support a bounded explanation of the observed relative configuration.
Electronic and Gibbs energy differences must remain distinct; exact ISC rates, a complete photophysical network, dr and the 99% yield are outside the required scope.
